judges.verdict: All 23 builds pass the core spec in my shared probes (hide siblings at every level, observe later additions, keep announcers and top-layer elements visible, multi-root targets, revert, flag off), and every one passes its own tests and lint. The bin/ deletion flagged against eight builds appears in all 23 diffs and comes from how the diffs were generated, not from the builds. What separates them is whether a shadow root inside another target is excluded. C, K, E, R, U, G, D, S, O, Q, L and N exclude it, while A, B, F, H, I, J, M, P, T, V and W hide content inside a target. After that come edge cases: slots (L and N put aria-hidden on a slotted target's slot), closed roots, announcers in unrelated shadow roots, I hiding the contents of a target that is a shadow host, and seven builds (B, H, I, O, P, Q, W) leaving yarn.lock out of date.
